title: hepetis fulgens
intro: Hepetis fulgens, commonly known as Mexican oregano or Mexican thyme, is a perennial shrub native to the mountainous regions of Mexico and Central America. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, alleviating digestive issues, and soothing respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Hepetis fulgens include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
